channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Hedgehog Wins Contest to Replace Historical Figures on UK Cash
item.description: Historical figures including the UK’s wartime prime minister Winston Churchill will be replaced on the country’s banknotes by images of an Atlantic puffin, a barn owl, a buff-tailed bumblebee and a European hedgehog, the Bank of England said.

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices today, October 8: Check rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai and more
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices remained unchanged across major cities on October 8 even as global crude oil prices rose amid supply concerns linked to the US-Iran war and disruptions around the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Christa Pike's health status: Woman who survived execution attempt ‘has pneumonia and no function in her arms’
item.description: Christa Pike's lawyer Randy Spivey described several medical issues, including a blood clot in one arm, pneumonia, the inability to swallow and no function in her arms.

item.title: India plans subject-expert inspectors for homoeopathic medicine manufacturing units
item.description: Inspectors of homoeopathic medicines must hold the appropriate qualifications, an industry body said, adding that domain expertise enables better guidance for manufacturers and pharmacists.

item.title: Govt weighs export floor price for cotton yarn to ensure domestic supplies
item.description: Cotton yarn prices have surged around 60%, from about ₹250 per kg in early 2026 to nearly ₹400 per kg now, putting pressure on textile manufacturers, particularly those that use yarn to produce fabrics and garments, per the industry proposal submitted to the textiles ministry and reviewed by Mint.

item.title: Colombia seeks deeper security ties with India to fight drug cartels
item.description: Colombia is eyeing enhanced law-enforcement cooperation with India to combat drug trafficking, focusing on drone shield technology from Bharat Electronics Ltd

item.title: US Forces in Okinawa Face Curfew After Marine’s Arrest
item.description: The US Forces in Okinawa paused operations for 48 hours starting at noon on Wednesday and imposed a month-long curfew on military personnel, following the arrest of a US Marine on suspicion of murdering a Japanese woman.

item.title: 9/11 families vs Saudi Arabia: Will Riyadh finally face trial? What the lawsuit alleges, what families want Trump to do
item.description: A federal appeals court in New York on Wednesday (October 7) heard arguments over whether the Kingdom should remain a defendant in a lawsuit alleging that Saudi government-linked individuals provided assistance to some of the 19 al-Qaida hijackers.

item.title: Trump’s $70,000 OPT fee proposal for international students explained: What is OPT and who will bear the cost?
item.description: DHS says the move is aimed at tackling fraud and abuse, strengthening the integrity of the immigration system and protecting US workers.

item.title: FBI arrests teen after alleged ISIS-inspired Mall of America terror plot: Inside the undercover sting
item.description: Authorities said the FBI sting operation disrupted an alleged plan to attack the Mall of America, one of the largest shopping centres in the United States.

item.title: Navratri 2026: Day-wise colours this year, significance, key dates, Navadurga celebrations and more
item.description: Navratri, a nine-night festival celebrating Goddess Durga, unites families and communities across India. Observances include fasting, aartis, and artistic displays of idols.&nbsp;

item.title: Trump administration proposes huge OPT fee hike from $500 to $70,000 for F-1 visa students seeking jobs in US
item.description: Under the proposal, F-1 students would have to pay $70,000 to a certified institution for on-the-job training through OPT, while any additional work training would carry a fee of $30,000, according to a government notice posted online on Wednesday.

item.title: IndiGo flight hit by lightning at 17,000 feet, aircraft's nose damaged; all 110 on board safe - What we know so far
item.description: IndiGo flight 6E925 was struck by lightning mid-air at 17,000 feet. The pilots landed safely in Lucknow, with all 110 people on board safe.

item.title: Hemant Soren’s mother passes away at 80, Jharkhand CM says: ‘Maa was my greatest shelter’ | All about Rupi Soren
item.description: The wife of Shibu Soren, founder of the Jharkhand Mukti Morcha, had been hospitalised since September 18 with breathing difficulty.

item.title: Seemapuri building collapse: Three dead, including pregnant woman and child, eight injured in Delhi – everything we know
item.description: According to the latest updates, eight people have been rescued in injured condition and were sent to hospitals. The incident took place a month after a building in Delhi's Satya Niketan collapsed on September 6, killing seven people.

item.title: Human activity is forcing this Himalayan bird to change its 'vocal frequency and address'
item.description: The research suggests that monals are being pushed towards higher elevations as their natural habitats become increasingly crowded.

item.title: Flydubai cockpit attack: Saudi Arabia opens aviation safety probe to examine risks after mid-air stabbing
item.description: The UAE has already opened a separate criminal investigation into the incident, which its prosecutor general has called a “terrorist attack.”

item.title: Southwest monsoon withdrawal advances, rainfall to continue in several states
item.description: The withdrawal typically starts from western Rajasthan in September before gradually progressing across northwest and central India, and subsequently moving toward the southern peninsula and eastern regions.

item.title: Trump-backed Ken Paxton admits Iran war, fuel prices are hurting his Texas Senate bid - Report
item.description: Paxton specifically pointed to diesel prices of more than $6 a gallon, saying higher fuel costs were being felt by consumers and were contributing to increased food prices and other expenses.

item.title: Meet Neuhof School Band from Mizoram: Winners of Yamaha Teens Rock 2026 - What maestro AR Rahman said about them
item.description: Yamaha Teens Rock 2026 grand finale was held in Bengaluru, attended by music director, singer AR Rahman. The winning band took home a cash prize of ₹4.5 lakh.

item.title: How YouTuber Sourav Joshi lives: Lavish bungalow with stunning Nainital-Bhimtal views, ₹1.6 crore Defender and more
item.description: Sourav Joshi, who has around 42 million subscribers on YouTube, hosted filmmaker and choreographer Farah Khan and her cook, Dilip, at his bungalow in Haldwani, Uttarakhand.

item.title: Modi calls for secure, open maritime order amid geopolitical disruptions
item.description: India’s maritime push is also being supported by its large seafarer workforce. Modi said Indian seafarers now constitute the world’s second-largest maritime workforce, with young Indians earning recognition across the world’s oceans. He said India is protecting ocean health and coastal ecosystems.

item.title: Mithun Chakraborty gets Cabinet Minister rank; appointed as advisor in CM Suvendu Adhikari's Bengal government
item.description: Actor-turned-politician Mithun Chakraborty has been declared as West Bengal govt's cultural advisor with cabinet minister rank.

item.title: Russia plague scare: 200 quarantined, 5,000 tests, no confirmed cases, no epidemic risk — latest updates
item.description: Siberia plague scare latest updates: Russia has ruled out an epidemic risk, while the WHO continues to seek more information about the laboratory worker’s unexplained death.

item.title: Opposition vs Gyanesh Kumar: Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi forcibly removed, detained during INDIA bloc protest in Delhi
item.description: Congress leaders, including Rahul and Priyanka Gandhi, were forcibly removed by police while protesting against Election Commission irregularities. Priyanka claimed mistreatment by police, calling it an attack on democracy. The MPs were detained after attempting to stage a sit-in near Jantar Mantar.

item.title: India, UK agree to explore cross-border equity, bond listings through GIFT IFSC
item.description: The agreement was part of the joint statement adopted after the fourth UK-India Financial Markets Dialogue, held in London on 29 September.

item.title: Isaias landfall forecast: Tropical storm heads for US Gulf Coast; Florida declares emergency
item.description: AccuWeather Hurricane Experts said Isaias is likely to become the first hurricane of the 2026 Atlantic season, potentially making it the latest first hurricane to form in the Atlantic basin in more than 100 years.

item.title: Trump vows $5,000 cheques to woo voters: Inside Republicans' move to save midterms amid Iran war woes
item.description: Ahead of the 3 November midterms, Trump has promised to pay every adult US citizen $5,000 if Republicans retain Congress while rolling out smaller ACA payments. The pitch comes as the Iran war, rising fuel costs and his falling approval rating put pressure on Republican prospects.

item.title: India-EFTA trade pact covers 99.6% of Indian exports: commerce secretary
item.description: Marking one year of TEPA, Rajesh Agrawal urged exporters to draft market-specific plans to tap the $500-billion EFTA market and a $100-billion investment pledge.

item.title: RBI to clarify forex reporting rules soon
item.description: RBI's updated forex norms have raised concerns among freelancers, content creators, and small service exporters about whether they now need to file additional export declarations for payments received from overseas.

item.title: Four-storey building collapses in Delhi's Seemapuri, several feared trapped
item.description: On Wednesday afternoon, the front portion of a four-storey residential building in the Seemapuri area collapsed. Rescue operations are underway. This comes a month after a PG collapse in the Satya Niketan area that claimed seven lives.

item.title: Chevron CEO warns ‘unwise’ US diesel export ban could worsen global fuel crunch | What it means
item.description: Chevron CEO Mike Wirth called a potential US diesel export ban “unwise”, warning it could worsen global fuel shortages and undermine America’s reputation as a reliable energy supplier amid rising tensions and supply disruptions.

item.title: India slams OIC's ‘willful blindness’ at UN, defends action against terror infrastructure in Pakistan, PoK
item.description: India hit back at the OIC at the UN, rejecting its remarks on Jammu and Kashmir and defending its actions against terrorist infrastructure in Pakistan and PoJK. BJP MP Biplab Kumar Deb said the OIC could not “differentiate between the victim and the perpetrator”.

item.title: ‘I saw him as an avatar of Vishnu’: Bhutan PM Tshering Tobgay lauds 'elder brother' PM Modi’s 25 years in public office
item.description: Bhutan PM Tshering Tobgay called PM Narendra Modi an “avatar of Vishnu” while praising his 25-year political journey. Tobgay linked Modi’s leadership to wisdom, compassion, courage and selfless service, calling them qualities of an enlightened ruler.

item.title: Vivek Agnihotri sparks ‘tax religion’ row, VHP seeks apology from Kashmir Files director
item.description: Kainchi Dham in Uttarakhand has experienced severe, unprecedented overcrowding and massive traffic jams, driven by the Gandhi Jayanti long weekend and heightened public interest following the release of the film Hanuman Ansh.&nbsp;
